# netactuate_bgp_prefix_purchase (Resource)

Purchases an anycast BGP prefix. The API has no release endpoint for purchased prefixes, so deleting this resource removes it from Terraform state only and leaves the prefix on the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_bgp_prefix_purchase" "example" {
  agreement_id = 12345
  name         = "example"
  group_id     = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agreement_id` (Number) Accepted legal agreement ID for the purchase.
- `name` (String) Prefix purchase name.

### Optional

- `anycast_profile` (Number) Anycast profile ID.
- `asn_id` (Number) BGP ASN ID used when group_id is not supplied.
- `group_id` (Number) BGP group ID to attach the prefix to.

### Read-Only

- `bgp_prefix_id` (Number) API assigned BGP prefix ID.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `prefix` (String) Purchased prefix.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_bgp_prefix_purchase.example 12345
```
